title: Resolution urging FIFA to pay NYC its promised $1 million
summary: This resolution calls on FIFA to pay New York City the $1 million “legacy contribution” it promised host cities for the 2026 World Cup. It notes the City spent an estimated $90 million hosting eight World Cup games at MetLife Stadium but expected only $51 million in tax revenue in return. The resolution cites an August 4, 2026 report finding FIFA had not made the promised payments to host cities.
